<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
defn(fn: Optional[Callable[..., Any]] = None, **options: Any) -> Any
```

Part of [`evoxc.trace`](/api/evoxc/trace/)

Mark `fn` as a graph definition. Usable bare or with options.

Usage:

```
@evoxc.defn
def model(x): ...

@evoxc.defn(compiler_hint="iree")   # reserved for the future
def model(x): ...
```

Idempotent: applying `defn` to an existing `Defn` returns it unchanged.
